visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a close-up of a vibrant arcade cabinet for 'Kingdoms Fantasy,' featuring stylized anime-style Three Kingdoms character artwork with intense lighting. (2) The perspective shifts to a smartphone screen where a user scans a QR code on the machine, transitioning to a mobile registration interface on the 'WA ZONE' website. (3) A screen recording shows the mobile app's card collection gallery, browsing through various character cards with stats and levels. (4) The camera returns to the cabinet's screen, displaying an active 3D battle scene and the 'Challenge Mode' selection UI. (5) A hand is shown holding and flicking through several high-quality physical trading cards with glossy holographic finishes. (6) On-screen animation features a character summoning sequence, revealing a 'Liu Bei SSR' card with flashing lights and golden effects. (7) Two men are filmed from behind as they sit at the arcade machine, actively using joysticks and oversized buttons to play the 3D action game. (8) The final shot is a handheld selfie of a man with a bun hairstyle smiling and nodding toward the camera in a brightly lit indoor arcade environment.

[Variety]: 收藏. (5) [Subtitle]: 還可以透過手機進行卡片能力等級與強化. (6) [Subtitle]: 除了可以獲得專屬卡片. (7) [Variety]: 普通 稀有 史詩 傳說. (8) [Subtitle]: 卡片也有分普通、稀有、史詩、傳說. (9) [Subtitle]: 連十點將我抽抽抽. (10) [Subtitle]: 每張卡片都是由專業的繪師美術團隊精心設計. (11) [Subtitle]: 展現三國時代英雄人物的經典戰役. (12) [Subtitle]: 像我這次就抽中了劉備SSR. [Variety]: 劉備 SSR. (13) [Subtitle]: 即將在1月18日正式上市. (14) [Subtitle]: 活動地點在台北地下街Y區5廣6廣12廣. audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Fast-paced, high-arousal rock BGM starts with heavy drums and distorted synth. An energetic male narrator introduces the game with quick, rising intonation. (2) A sharp 'whoosh' transition SFX triggers as the narrator describes the mobile registration. The acoustic environment is clean with slight reverb. (3) Digital UI 'ping' sounds occur every time a card is tapped in the app demo. BGM maintains a driving 4/4 beat. (4) Explosive impact SFX and sword-clashing sounds from the game screen blend with the BGM. Narrator's vocal arousal increases during the card reveal phase. (5) High-pitched 'sparkle' SFX rings out when the SSR card is revealed. The narrator's speech has a noticeable delay/echo effect applied for emphasis. (6) Narrator lists locations in Taipei Underground Mall; BGM volume ducks slightly to ensure verbal clarity. (7) Final transition SFX with a metallic hit ends the track as the narrator delivers a high-energy closing catchphrase.
